item.title: Euclidean Algorithm
item.description: The Euclidean Algorithm is a highly efficient method for computing the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two integers, the largest number that divides them both without leaving a remainder. The algorithm is based on the principle that the greatest common divisor of two numbers does not change if the larger number is replaced by its difference with the smaller number. Since this replacement reduces the larger of the two numbers, repeating this process gives successively smaller pairs of numbers until the two numbers become equal.
